title: Trade tensions rise as US and Canada clash over lake name
subtitle: A dispute over the name of Lake Ontario highlights a growing economic conflict between the two neighbors

summary.en: President Trump has ordered US government agencies to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America. This move is part of a larger trade war involving high taxes on Canadian goods. Canadian officials have strongly rejected the name change, calling it a sign of bullying. Google Maps has updated its labels to reflect the US government's new name for American users. The situation remains tense as both sides continue to exchange harsh words and economic actions.
summary.zh: 川普總統下令美國政府機構將安大略湖更名為美國湖。此舉是涉及對加拿大商品課徵高額關稅的貿易戰之一環。加拿大官員強烈拒絕更名，稱其為霸凌的表現。Google 地圖已更新標籤，以反映美國政府對美國用戶的新命名。由於雙方持續進行激烈的言詞交鋒與經濟制裁，局勢依然緊張。

paragraphs.en: The relationship between the United States and Canada is facing a period of intense pressure. While the two nations have long been close partners, a new dispute over the name of Lake Ontario has become a symbol of their failing trade talks. On Thursday, President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing all US federal agencies to refer to the body of water as "Lake America."
paragraphs.zh: 美國與加拿大的關係正處於高度緊張的時期。儘管兩國長期以來是密切的合作夥伴，但近期關於安大略湖（Lake Ontario）名稱的爭議，已成為雙方貿易談判破裂的象徵。週四，美國總統川普（Donald Trump）簽署了一項行政命令，指示所有美國聯邦機構將該水域稱為「美國湖」（Lake America）。

paragraphs.en: This decision is part of a larger economic conflict. Recently, trade negotiations between the two countries collapsed, leading the US to announce a 50% tariff — a tax on imported goods — on Canadian steel. According to NPR News, Canada has promised to respond with its own taxes, matching the US "dollar for dollar." President Trump stated that he decided to rename the lake because he believes Canada has been unfair in trade deals, telling reporters that Canada is the "worst to deal with."
paragraphs.zh: 這項決定是更大規模經濟衝突的一部分。近期，兩國之間的貿易談判陷入僵局，導致美國宣布對加拿大鋼鐵徵收百分之五十的關稅，即針對進口商品課稅。根據美國公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，加拿大承諾將採取對等稅收措施，以「美元對美元」的方式回擊美國。川普總統表示，他決定更改湖名是因為他認為加拿大在貿易協議中不公平，並向記者稱加拿大是「最難打交道的對象」。

paragraphs.en: In response to the president's order, Canadian leaders have taken a firm stand. Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a giant billboard near the border on Saturday. The sign, which is two stories high, declares "Lake Ontario. Now and Always." According to The Guardian World, Ford argued that the name of the lake is based on an Indigenous Wendat word meaning "the lake is beautiful, the lake is great," and that it has been used for over 400 years. Ford told reporters that Canada will not back down from what he described as a bully.
paragraphs.zh: 針對總統的命令，加拿大領導人採取了堅定的立場。安大略省省長福特（Doug Ford）週六在邊境附近揭幕了一塊巨大的廣告看板。這塊兩層樓高的看板上寫著「安大略湖，現在與永遠」。根據英國衛報（The Guardian）報導，福特指出，該湖的名稱源自原住民溫達特語（Wendat），意為「這座湖很美麗、這座湖很偉大」，且已被使用了超過四百年。福特告訴記者，加拿大不會向他口中的霸凌者低頭。

paragraphs.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has also rejected the name change. On the social media platform X, Carney stated that Canadians know things must be called by their real names, and that the lake will remain Lake Ontario "today and forever." Meanwhile, in the United States, not all officials agree with the president. New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced that her state, which shares a border with the lake, will continue to use the traditional name.
paragraphs.zh: 加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）也拒絕接受這項更名。他在社群媒體平台 X 上表示，加拿大人知道事物必須以其真實名稱稱呼，該湖「今天以及未來」都將維持安大略湖的名稱。與此同時，在美國國內，並非所有官員都認同總統的作法。紐約州州長侯可（Kathy Hochul）宣布，與該湖接壤的紐約州將繼續使用傳統名稱。

paragraphs.en: Technology companies are now caught in the middle of this disagreement. Google has updated Google Maps to reflect the name change for users within the United States. In a statement reported by The Guardian World, the company explained that its policy is to follow official government sources when naming locations. As a result, US users now see the label "Lake America." However, Google noted that this change does not affect Canadian users, who will continue to see "Lake Ontario" on their maps. People in other parts of the world will see both names listed.
paragraphs.zh: 科技公司現在也捲入了這場爭議。谷歌（Google）已更新了 Google 地圖，以反映美國境內用戶的名稱變更。根據衛報報導，該公司在聲明中解釋，其政策是在命名地點時遵循官方政府來源。因此，美國用戶現在看到的標籤是「美國湖」。然而，谷歌指出，這項變更不會影響加拿大用戶，他們在地圖上仍會看到「安大略湖」。至於世界其他地區的用戶，則會同時看到這兩個名稱。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time such a dispute has occurred during the current US administration. Last year, President Trump issued a similar order to rename the Gulf of Mexico as the "Gulf of America." That move also led to a legal disagreement and changes on digital maps. During his recent announcement at the Oval Office, the president suggested that he might continue this pattern, joking that "all we need is an ocean" to complete the set of renamed bodies of water.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非本屆美國政府任內首次發生此類爭議。去年，川普總統曾發布類似命令，將墨西哥灣更名為「美國灣」（Gulf of America）。該舉動同樣引發了法律爭議與數位地圖上的變更。在白宮橢圓形辦公室最近的一次宣布中，總統暗示他可能會延續這種模式，並開玩笑說「我們只需要一個海洋」就能湊齊這一系列更名的水域。

paragraphs.en: To keep the pressure on, the US president has used social media to share AI-generated videos. One video showed him dancing to the song "YMCA" while replacing a sign for Lake Ontario with one for Lake America. Another video featured images of geese with blond hair, styled to look like the president, "protecting" the lake. These actions have further frustrated Canadian officials, who see the renaming as a distraction from the serious economic issues at hand.
paragraphs.zh: 為了持續施壓，美國總統利用社群媒體分享人工智慧生成的影片。其中一段影片顯示他隨著歌曲「YMCA」起舞，同時將安大略湖的標誌換成美國湖的標誌。另一段影片則出現了長著金髮、造型模仿總統的鵝，宣稱正在「保護」該湖。這些舉動進一步激怒了加拿大官員，他們認為這種更名行為只是為了轉移大眾對當前嚴重經濟問題的注意力。

paragraphs.en: As the trade war continues, the future of the relationship between the two countries remains uncertain. The 50% tariff on Canadian steel has already caused significant concern for businesses on both sides of the border. With trade talks currently stalled, both nations are preparing for a long period of economic difficulty. For now, the name of the lake remains a major point of conflict, reflecting the deep divide between the two neighbors. While the US government moves forward with its new name, Canadian leaders remain committed to their own identity and sovereignty, promising that the lake will keep its original name long after the current political disputes have ended.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著貿易戰持續，兩國關係的未來仍充滿不確定性。對加拿大鋼鐵徵收的百分之五十關稅，已對邊境兩側的企業造成重大擔憂。由於貿易談判目前陷入停滯，兩國都在為長期的經濟困難做準備。目前，湖泊名稱仍是主要的衝突點，反映了這兩個鄰國之間深層的分歧。儘管美國政府持續推動新名稱，加拿大領導人仍堅持維護自身的認同與主權，並承諾即使在當前的政治爭端結束後，該湖仍將長期保留其原始名稱。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop making progress or to be delayed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（攤位），這裡作動詞表示進展停滯。文中：With trade talks currently stalled, both nations are preparing for a long period of economic difficulty.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop demanding something or to stop fighting because you realize you will not win.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞與介詞組成，意思無法從字面拆解。文中：Ford told reporters that Canada will not back down from what he described as a bully.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be involved in a difficult situation between two opposing sides.
keyTerms.noteZh: 形容處於兩方衝突的尷尬位置。文中：Technology companies are now caught in the middle of this disagreement.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Being dealt with or under consideration right now.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「在手邊」，這裡指「當前正在處理的」。文中：These actions have further frustrated Canadian officials, who see the renaming as a distraction from the serious economic issues at hand.

The US recently placed high taxes on $20 billion worth of Canadian products. In response, Canadian citizens are boycotting American goods and services across the country. Tensions grew further after the US president ordered that Lake Ontario be renamed 'Lake America'. Canadian leaders and citizens alike are pushing back against these actions with strong public protests.

quiz.question: What is the specific reason provided by Ontario Premier Doug Ford for rejecting the name change of the lake?

options.A: He believes the name 'Lake America' is grammatically incorrect.
options.B: He argues the name is rooted in an Indigenous word with a 400-year history.
options.C: He claims that the US president does not have the legal authority to rename international borders.
options.D: He is concerned that changing the name will negatively impact the local tourism industry.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，安大略省省長 Doug Ford 明確指出，該湖泊的名稱源自於原住民 Wendat 語言，意指「這座湖很美、很偉大」，且該名稱已被使用了超過 400 年。選項 A 文章未提及；選項 C 雖然提到加拿大領導人採取強硬立場，但並未引用法律權限作為反對理由；選項 D 雖然是現實中可能的後果，但文中並未提及旅遊業。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what can be inferred about the relationship between the US government and Google regarding the name change?

options.A: Google actively supports the US president's economic policies.
options.B: Google is forced to follow US government directives to avoid being fined.
options.C: Google follows a standardized policy of using official government sources for geographical names.
options.D: Google is intentionally trying to provoke Canadian users by changing the map labels.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，Google 說明其政策是根據「官方政府來源」來命名地點，因此在美國境內顯示「Lake America」。這暗示 Google 是基於其既定的命名政策行事，而非出於對特定政策的支持或被迫。選項 A 無法由文中得知；選項 B 文中未提及罰款；選項 D 與文章內容矛盾，因為 Google 對加拿大用戶仍顯示原始名稱，並非為了挑釁。

quiz.question: In the phrase 'Canada will not back down from what he described as a bully,' what does the word 'bully' imply in this context?

options.A: A person or entity that uses strength to intimidate others.
options.B: A political leader who is very popular with the public.
options.C: A negotiator who is highly skilled at reaching compromises.
options.D: A person who is physically larger than their opponents.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此上下文中，「bully」指的是利用權力或威脅來強迫他人屈服的對象。Doug Ford 將美國總統的行為比喻為霸凌，是因為美國透過關稅和強制改名等強硬手段施壓。選項 B 與文中描述的緊張關係不符；選項 C 與「霸凌」的負面含義完全相反；選項 D 雖然字面上有體型大小的意涵，但在這裡是指政治上的強勢壓迫，而非單純指身體大小。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: The US and Canada are successfully resolving their trade disputes through diplomatic dialogue.
options.B: The dispute over the lake's name is a minor issue that has no impact on the two countries' economies.
options.C: The renaming of the lake is a symbolic manifestation of a deeper, ongoing economic and political conflict.
options.D: Google Maps is the primary cause of the current political tension between the US and Canada.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章開頭與結尾皆強調，湖泊名稱的爭議是兩國經濟衝突與關係緊張的象徵。文章透過貿易戰、關稅及改名事件，呈現出兩國深層的分歧。選項 A 與文意完全相反；選項 B 錯誤，文中明確提到這與貿易戰相關；選項 D 錯誤，Google 只是被捲入爭議的第三方，並非衝突的起因。
